title: erysimum sylvestre subsp. aurantiacum
intro: Erysimum sylvestre subsp. aurantiacum, commonly known as wallflower, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Erysimum sylvestre subsp. aurantiacum include anti-cancer, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
